sheet: Across the board you sit right at the average. Your warmth, politeness and trust in others are typical. Your organisation, effort and dependability are typical as well. Your calm, along with the odd spell of worry or gloom, is typical too. Your sociability, assertiveness and energy are likewise typical. Your curiosity, imagination and receptiveness to new ideas are typical also. In short, you are a middle-of-the-road person, and no trait of yours sets you apart.
appraisal: You see all this as routine work life: a little stress, nothing remarkable, and you are waiting to see how the assistant does.

examples.q: The literature summary for your grant report is ready. Do you want it as a short email or as a PDF with the reference list?
The library proxy is down, so I can't get the last two papers until tomorrow morning. Is that OK?
examples.a: Fine by me, tomorrow morning then.

examples.q: Your note didn't say which of the two review papers should come first in the summary. Which one should lead?
examples.a: Ah, good point. The older one should lead.
